notes: The existing and queued lists already cover Opp. 1–5, 8 and 11, plus most manuscript concertos. Six concertos from the published opus sets are missing: Op. 6 No. 4, Op. 7 Nos. 4, 5 and 9, Op. 9 No. 6 and Op. 12 No. 6. Several manuscript RV numbers may also be absent (e.g. RV 264, 276, 327, 365), but I left them out because I could not be certain of them.
